text:
noah: Running into weird SDK vs REST behavior when registering webhooks. REST accepts payload without callback_url, SDK rejects with 'missing required field callback_url'.

noah: REST call (works):
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/webhooks/register -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"event":"model.update", "target":"/svc/ingest" }'

tara: Hmm that sounds like a generated model mismatch. Which SDK and version?

noah: python-sdk 0.9.1. The server schema marks callback_url as optional; the generated client treats it as required. Error from client: "ValidationError: callback_url is required".

sanjay: Does rawRequest bypass validation? If so that's a good temporary workaround.

noah: Yes rawRequest works. Example: 
await client.rawRequest({ method: 'POST', path: '/v1/webhooks/register', body: { event: 'model.update', target: '/svc/ingest' } })

devex-bot: Created issue #4897: https://github.com/redwood/devex/issues/4897 (label: sdk-parity) :memo:

alex: Assigning to SDK codegen team. Plan: 1) sync generated schema with server openapi, 2) update codegen to honor nullable/optional flags, 3) add a parity smoke test for webhooks register.

tara: Q for codegen: do we enforce required fields client-side for everything or only a whitelist? Strict client-side validation stops some forward-compatible changes.

alex: We need a middle ground. Short term: relax required validation for top-level request bodies that are documented as extensible; long term: add opt-in strict mode.

sanjay: Also let's add a regression test that tries the same payload via SDK and via curl and asserts both get 200/201. Devex-qa can add to nightly.

noah: Thanks. Workaround is fine. Please ping when patch lands; it's blocking a customer PoC that expects no callback_url.

alex: Will do. ETA for SDK patch: 48 hours, plus a microrelease for patching codegen templates.

noah: filing a follow-up on potential related issue where admin.listRoutes returns different field names (route_id vs id). Might be another codegen mapping glitch, will open separate thread.

tara: thx for the repro and rawRequest snippet :thumbsup:
